reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off, toys cleaned after use and capped numbers are exactly what I look for with a baby who mouths everything. A free first visit means I can check it myself before paying, and $15 for my 4-year-old with the baby free is fair.
objection: I will believe the cleaning claims when I see them. If the toys look grubby or the log is just a clipboard nobody fills in, I am out after the free visit. It is also not open yet, so it is just words right now.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning log and how toys are actually sanitized in person, or good reviews from other parents saying it is truly clean.
